meta.title: 유의해야 할 비교급 구문
meta.note: 교재 p.86~87과 정답·해설 p.62의 대표 Q01~Q03 원문·정답 논리를 대조해 특수 비교구문 중심의 대표 source-aligned QA 세트로 변환함.

items.display: Q01 · not so much A as B
items.sentence: Employers, at the point of graduation, may not so much treasure a student's grades as the habits and attitudes which those grades signify.
items.prompt: 고용주들이 더 중요하게 생각하는 대상으로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
items.explanation: not so much A as B는 ‘A라기보다는 오히려 B’이므로 B인 the habits and attitudes를 더 중요하게 여깁니다.
items.memory: not so much A as B → A라기보다는 오히려 B

items.sentence: It makes no sense to speculate or ask your friends about why people do certain things, because friends have no more insight than you have.
items.prompt: friends have no more insight than you have의 의미로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
choices: 당신이 통찰력이 없는 것처럼 친구들도 통찰력이 없다
친구들은 당신보다 더 많은 통찰력을 가진다
items.answer: 당신이 통찰력이 없는 것처럼 친구들도 통찰력이 없다
items.explanation: A no more ... than B는 ‘B가 아닌 것처럼 A도 ~ 아니다’의 의미로 해석됩니다.

items.sentence: The only rational way to find it out is to ask the person who did it why he or she did it.
items.explanation: 주어 중심은 The only rational way이고 to find it out은 이를 수식하므로 본동사는 is입니다.

items.sentence: Material incentives are no less important in stimulating invention than they are in encouraging other economic activities, but they are far from the only drivers of innovation.
items.prompt: than they are 뒤에 의미상 반복되어 생략된 형용사를 입력하세요.
items.explanation: 물질적 장려책이 다른 경제 활동을 장려하는 데 중요한 것처럼이라는 비교이므로 important가 반복되어 생략됩니다.

items.sentence: Material incentives are no less important in stimulating invention than they are in encouraging other economic activities.
choices: Material incentives are just as important in stimulating invention as they are in encouraging other economic activities.
Material incentives are less important in stimulating invention than in encouraging other economic activities.
items.answer: Material incentives are just as important in stimulating invention as they are in encouraging other economic activities.
items.explanation: A no less ... than B는 A just as ... as B와 같은 의미입니다.
